form: lane (BUILD-Q-33): admission by scoped, expiring, revocable, single-use Authority grants; site-born specimen custody

identity.fingerprint_form: SHA-256 of the 65-byte uncompressed public key (0x04||X||Y)
identity.note: The specimen is born at THIS site by the host bootstrap and held in the site SKAP tree. It is never copied from another site. For the production 8374 identity, continuity with the published address is proven through the ecosystem SKAP retrieval path (BUILD-Q-25); a lane site's own specimen keys the lane site's signing plane and is receipted as its own specimen.

custody.form: site SKAP tree (lane form): a directory in the instance tree holding specimen_key.json (mode 0600, born at the site) and the Authority store. The signing material is loaded per signing call and zeroized after use; it is never cached between calls, never logged.
custody.material_policy: loaded per call, zeroized after use, never cached, never written elsewhere, never logged

admitted_scope.note: A grant admits a signing call only when it names exactly this triple, is unexpired, unrevoked, and unused. Grants are issued by the site Authority (signing/authority.py) and consumed by the admitted call.

signing.input: payload_digest: the SHA-256 digest (64 hex) of the payload to sign; the digest itself is signed (Prehashed)
